claim_ceiling: Source audit only. No production fix, test pass, physical measurement, engine benchmark or safety qualification.

observations.fact: RigidBody exposes mass, inverse mass, inertia and inverse inertia as public fields.
observations.risk: Callers can mutate the source value and cached reciprocal independently.

observations.fact: RigidBody::new accepts SVector<f64,D> and computes elementwise reciprocal for positive entries.
observations.risk: No declared frame/principal-moment contract or input validation is enforced here.
3D solid-sphere moment is reused for D other than 3.

observations.fact: kinetic_energy uses arithmetic mean of inertia entries.
observations.risk: Anisotropic plane-dependent and orientation-dependent energy is discarded.

observations.fact: merge_toolhead averages base inertia, assumes 0.1 m solid-sphere toolhead and writes one scalar to every axis.
observations.risk: Shape, orientation and products of inertia are lost.

observations.fact: PhysicsWorld exposes Vec<RigidBody<D>> as a public field.
observations.risk: Mutation can bypass body_mut and any future validation hooks.

observations.fact: add_body rewrites handle and inserts supplied body without mass-property validation.
observations.risk: Invalid or internally inconsistent inverse caches may enter the world.

observations.fact: Deterministic insertion assigns network IDs and inserts supplied bodies without mass-property validation.
body_mut returns &mut RigidBody<D> without restricting mass-property fields.
resolve_contact computes mean inverse inertia for both bodies.
observations.risk: Contact response is isotropized before normal/friction effective-mass calculation.

observations.fact: Normal contact denominator uses mean inverse inertia times lever-arm scalar.
observations.risk: Anisotropic world-frame angular compliance is not represented.

observations.fact: Tangential friction denominator uses mean inverse inertia times lever-arm scalar.
observations.risk: Friction-induced angular response inherits the same approximation.

observations.fact: Accumulated torque is integrated with mean inverse inertia.
observations.risk: All bivector planes receive the same angular acceleration scalar.

observations.fact: apply_angular_impulse multiplies every angular impulse component by mean inverse inertia.
observations.risk: Impulse response ignores anisotropy and body orientation.

observations.fact: The passive hinge solver directly changes angular-velocity components.
observations.risk: Must be audited against a declared constraint Jacobian and effective-inertia weighting.

observations.fact: Baseline main has velocity-only motor path with fixed split; PR #6411 proposes step-scoped target/impulse budgeting but retains isotropic mean inertia.
observations.risk: Motor semantics and full tensor response are separate gates.

observations.fact: The passive prismatic solver directly adjusts angular-velocity components for constrained planes.
observations.risk: Must be audited against a declared constraint Jacobian and effective-inertia weighting.

observations.fact: 3D articulated link construction uses dynamic_sphere while LinkSpec includes length and radius.
observations.risk: The mass distribution does not model the stated link geometry.

observations.fact: RigidBody is publicly re-exported from the crate.
observations.risk: Public-field mutation is a downstream API concern, not confined to the module.
